verdict.rationale: Built-in utilities are a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. The pack names default apps such as Firefox, Thunderbird, Nautilus, Gedit, Evince, LibreOffice and a Calculator, but nothing documents calendar, weather, maps or clock apps shipping out of the box. Generic claims like "thousands of applications" refer to installable software, not preinstalled utilities.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can rely on built-in utilities like calendar, weather, maps, and clock apps out of the box
